doc: Resident write-in comments from the 2025 Plan to Play online survey, reproduced in Metro's adopted Appendix F (Survey Results, A-300 to A-424). These are public input, not Metro commitments. Raw count of "Highland Rim" across the Appendix: 36 mentions; after removing answers one respondent repeated across questions, 30 distinct comments are listed here. Metro's own survey summary (A-113) groups related input under "Nature Preservation & Tree Canopy" (163 mentions) and does not name the Highland Rim.
